## Findings
<a id="findings"></a>

- <a id="research.backend-src-common.ff5bc729"></a>**1. The unit's only source file, backend/src/common/types.ts, exports three shared declarations: the PdfType enum, the ParsedEvent interface, and the JobStatus enum.**
  [`types.ts:1-26`](../types.ts#L1-L26)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common.a5858b7f"></a>**2. PdfType classifies the kind of PDF being processed: LECTURE denotes a recurring weekly schedule, TEST a one-time semester test schedule, and EXAM a one-time final exam schedule.**
  [`job-status.dto.ts:28-39`](../../jobs/dto/job-status.dto.ts#L28-L39)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common.f8a0ebc0"></a>**3. The parser unit consumes ParsedEvent as the shape of a parsed event: ParserService.parsePdf returns Promise<ParsedEvent[]> and ParserResponse carries events: ParsedEvent[].**
  [`parser.service.ts:8-10`](../../parser/parser.service.ts#L8-L10)
  [`parser.service.ts:26-26`](../../parser/parser.service.ts#L26-L26)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common.b02968d6"></a>**4. JobStatus represents the lifecycle of a PDF processing job: PENDING means the job is queued and waiting to be processed, PROCESSING means it is being processed by the PDF worker, COMPLETED means it finished successfully, and FAILED means it failed.**
  [`job-status.dto.ts:14-26`](../../jobs/dto/job-status.dto.ts#L14-L26)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common.42ee29f8"></a>**5. backend/src/common/types.ts is imported by nine files across the calendar, jobs, parser, upload, and common/validators units.**
  [`add-events.dto.ts:5-5`](../../calendar/dto/add-events.dto.ts#L5-L5)
  [`generate-ics.dto.ts:5-5`](../../calendar/dto/generate-ics.dto.ts#L5-L5)

  [`job-result.dto.ts:12-12`](../../jobs/dto/job-result.dto.ts#L12-L12)
  [`job-status.dto.ts:4-4`](../../jobs/dto/job-status.dto.ts#L4-L4)
  [`jobs.controller.ts:12-12`](../../jobs/jobs.controller.ts#L12-L12)
  [`parser.service.ts:5-5`](../../parser/parser.service.ts#L5-L5)
  [`upload-response.dto.ts:4-4`](../../upload/dto/upload-response.dto.ts#L4-L4)
  [`upload.service.ts:4-4`](../../upload/upload.service.ts#L4-L4)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common.65f47d6a"></a>**6. PdfType is a string-valued enum whose members LECTURE, TEST, and EXAM map to the values 'lecture', 'test', and 'exam'.**
  [`types.ts:1-5`](../types.ts#L1-L5)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common.75aee1be"></a>**7. ParsedEvent is an interface with required id, module, activity, startTime, endTime, venue, and isRecurring fields, and optional group, day, date, and semester fields.**
  [`types.ts:7-19`](../types.ts#L7-L19)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common.7fb2a50a"></a>**8. JobStatus is a string-valued enum whose members PENDING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, and FAILED map to the values 'pending', 'processing', 'completed', and 'failed'.**
  [`types.ts:21-26`](../types.ts#L21-L26)
